Judge Dredd™ introduces additional special action buttons. We recommend reviewing your control layout to ensure the default assignments match your preferences. If needed, button mappings can be customized in the Controls Settings menu.

Dear Pinball Fans,

We released a hotfix (1.0.35) for Pinball FX on Steam to address bugs that appeared after the latest patch, including issues on the Star Trek: The Next Generation™ and the Williams™ Pinball Volume 10 tables. Thank you to everyone who reported these issues!
Let’s check out the fixes!

Fire!™
Comet™

A new patch just arrived to Pinball FX, featuring 3 new Williams tables, exciting new features, optimizations, and a long list of bug fixes. Thank you to everyone who reported these issues!
Let’s check out the full list!

The removal of World Cup Soccer is a work in progress. Players who purchased the table will be able to play it without interruption.
The Williams™ Pinball Premium Collection has been reworked without World Cup Soccer.
Williams™ Pinball Volume 10 Questline is now available.
Platform friends are now fully integrated into the game. Players can invite friends to Events and Tournaments and create private tournaments exclusively for platform friends.

A new Duel mode has been introduced. It is a chain-based challenge where players compete directly against a friend. One player sets a score, the opponent must beat it, and the challenge continues back and forth until one player can no longer surpass the other’s score.
Players can track their rivalry with detailed Duel statistics, showing who is ahead overall across multiple duels.
A new Invisible option is available in Profile settings, allowing players to hide their in-game presence from their platform friends list and disable all related features.

These interactions are supported by an expanded notification system. Notifications are now split into two categories: Actions and Notifications. The Actions tab contains important messages that require player interaction, while the Notifications tab includes all other updates and information.
Removed the 999-player cap from unlimited user-generated tournaments, allowing more players to join and submit scores.
Improved Table Guide readability by increasing font size.
Improved handling of long player names in Tournament lists to prevent UI overflow issues.
Empty characters in the Enter Initials screen are saved as '6' on the local leaderboard on the Diner™ table.
On Williams™ Pinball Volume 10 tables in Hotseat mode, multiple players may share the same color instead of each having a distinct one.
Fixed an issue where claiming a Grand Tournament reward from a notification did not display the reward popup.
Fixed the leaderboard percentage indicator, which shows players what top percentage they rank in compared to all participants.
Fixed an issue where the 'Play Again' button remained active on the Tournament results screen even when no attempts were left.
Fixed an issue where Williams tables were incorrectly displayed under the Zen Originals category in the Collection screen.
Fixed an issue where posters could not be equipped or replaced in the PinHall on some occasions.
Fixed an issue where non–Grand Tournament events displayed a “Tier: Unranked” label on the results screen.
Fixed an issue where two Western Season reward carpets shared the same icon in the Collection.
The Machine™: Bride of Pin·Bot™
Fixed an issue where scores above 10 billion could not be properly recorded on leaderboards due to overflow.

[p align="start"]A new patch is now available for Pinball FX with new features, optimizations, and several bug fixes. Thank you to everyone who reported these issues!

General UI improvements for a cleaner presentation and smoother navigation across menus.

[p align="start"]

items.text: Fixed an issue where collectibles didn’t increase the Imaginationland Wizard Mode Jackpot on subsequent activations. The jackpot now correctly includes collectible bonuses every time the mode starts.

Fixed an issue where the Enter Initials screen could appear during Attract Mode after the Match sequence; also prevented unintended ballout animations from triggering.

Adjusted autoplunger behavior and strength.
General physics improvements for smoother and more accurate ball behavior.
Please note: We are aware of an issue on Scared Stiff, which is the following:
Playfield lights do not fully darken as intended during Spin Spider mode and Tilt, with some general illumination remaining active.

releases.displayName: A Legendary Music Update arrived for Jurassic World™ Pinball!

items.text: “Welcome to Jurassic Park.”
We are happy to announce that the Jurassic Park Pinball and Jurassic Park Pinball Mayhem tables have been updated with music from the original film.
Relive your favorite Jurassic Park moments, now in pinball form, while listening to the iconic score.
We're also happy to say that starting today, you can switch between Normal and Realistic physics on all three Jurassic World™ Pinball tables.
Jurassic Park™ Pinball plays through classic scenes from the original blockbuster film, from classic T. rex confrontations to outsmarting raptors in the kitchen.
Jurassic Park Pinball Mayhem™ returns us to Isla Nublar to restore order in an action-packed extravaganza -- playable Stegosaurus included!

Jurassic World™ Pinball enables you to train Raptors, view the spectacular Mosasaurus feeding, and escape the deadly Indominus Rex. You'll even experience Gyrosphere Valley using a playable gyrosphere pinball.: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351796?utm_source=steamnews: Experience these amazing tables like never before!

items.text: Heyho Pinball Fans,
The holiday season came early in Pinball FX, as we released nine amazing tables and quality-of-life updates. Let’s see the new tables!

Boldly go, where no one has gone before in Star Trek™ Pinball! Explore 3 tables based on the fan-favorite movies and TV series of the franchise ranging from classics to the present day, and live long and prosper on the leaderboards!

Get ready for a game-changing experience as Zen Studios partners up with Asmodee to bring you three tables based on the best tabletop games. Step into a new realm of pinball, and remember, just like with the dice, a single flip can change everything.
Find the real meaning of Christmas in A Charlie Brown Christmas™ Pinball! Join the Peanuts crew in putting on a play and decorating the most perfect tree there is.
Support pinball & charity with this 2-pack!

Your purchase of Epic Quest and Excalibur brings joy to those in need & helps preserve pinball culture, as Zen will donate 50% of the proceeds to Project Pinball (United States 46-3417202) and 50% to the Budapest Pinball Museum (Hungary MK/20980/2013) for each sale of this product.

releases.displayName: A huge update is coming to Pinball FX - Part 1

items.text: Dear Pinball Fans!
We are back with more surprises for our December 7 update! Buckle up and take a look at all these awesomeness coming to Pinball FX in 2 weeks!

Boldly go, where no one has gone before in Star Trek™ Pinball! Explore 3 tables based on the fan-favorite movies and TV series of the franchise ranging from classics to the present day, and live long and prosper on the leaderboards!

Join Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the Enterprise on their mission to discover new civilizations, form alliances, and neutralize threats to the Federation on Star Trek™ Pinball: Kelvin Timeline.

Star Trek™ Pinball: Discovery: Michael Burnham and the shipmates of the U.S.S. Discovery rely on your pinball prowess, as you play through iconic moments from the first four seasons of the series. Make contact with the residents of 10-C and utilize the time loop for victory!

Travel to the edges of the final frontier and arrive at the space station Deep Space 9! Use your pinball skills to lead the crew and Captain Benjamin Sisko in ending the Dominion War on Star Trek™ Pinball: Deep Space Nine!

And there is more! Two of the most popular Zen Originals are making their debut in Pinball FX. The Charity Pack combining Epic Quest and Excalibur will bring joy to those in need and help to preserve pinball culture, as Zen will donate 50% of the proceeds to Project Pinball (United States 46-3417202) and 50% to the Budapest Pinball Museum (Hungary MK/20980/2013) for each sale of this product.
The enthusiastic knight Max travels once more to defeat evil monsters, rescue the wealthy princess, and look for restitution in the way of valuable loot. Surely an Epic Quest if ever there was one!

The legend of Excalibur reveals the path to become a renowned and noble knight of King Arthur. Start Merlin's Magical Multiball or duel with other knights in Camelot - a seat at the round table awaits the victor.

Now you have seen all the new tables coming to Pinball FX on December 7, however we will have new features coming as well! Keep an eye on our next news item, or check out the latest Pinball Bites for more info.
See you on the leaderboards!
Linne
